source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.leaves: Long-petioled, palmately compound, 4–7 lanceolate to oblanceolate leaflets, nearly glabrous above; apices obtuse to acute or shortly pointed
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Erect terminal racemes with conspicuous white pointed tips from hairy unopened buds
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Deep blue petals, rarely white; standard with white central spot changing magenta-red, with yellow-green dots
morphology_source_reported.diagnostic_characters: Distinct white pointed raceme tips and noninflated straight wing petals contrasted with L. subcarnosus

cautions: 1999 Flora describes Texas endemism and roadside cultivation, but neither confirms BONAP county evidence
Historical name and morphology require independent corroboration before identification scoring
Regional distribution statements do not prove Hays County nativity
